title: Tuesdays, the last
logline: The Legacy with its hood up in Gully's lot for what the book takes as the last time, fifteen years of Tuesdays, Gully under it, and this time Wood under it too, both from behind, two backs and the pup between the boots. 'Hm', not lettered.

panels.composition: A faded green station wagon with its hood up in a gravel lot, a heavy gray man and a thin man in plaid both bent under the hood from behind, an old three-legged dog sitting between their boots, February light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a faded green station wagon with its hood raised in a gravel lot with a heavy gray-haired man and a thin man in plaid flannel both bent under the hood seen from behind and an old three-legged dog sitting between their boots, February light, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
